profile.headline: Software Engineer Intern at Kynship  |  Computer Science Student
profile.summary:
I've always been drawn to details, building systems, and finding more efficient ways to get things done, long before I was paid for it. Ask my wife, it was one of the first things she noticed about me. That mindset has shaped my experience in marketing, financial forecasting, design, and now my transition into software engineering. 

I'm currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, with an expected graduation date of November 2027. My previous experience taught me to approach problems with data, connect decisions to measurable outcomes, and translate ambiguous goals into practical solutions. 

Now, I'm applying that foundation to software development and building the technical skills needed to create useful, thoughtful, and well-designed systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Working with Kynship’s software team to improve and build internal and client-facing tools, including projects designed for use across the business.
 - User flow
 - System Design
 - Software Development
I create strong feedback and direction, connecting real-world needs to the development lifecycle, bringing business context directly into how tools are designed and improved.

positions.title: Growth Strategist
positions.description:
As a Growth Strategist at Kynship, I helped direct-to-consumer brands turn their business goals into data-driven growth strategies. I partnered with C-suite executives to align paid media and creative strategy with each brand’s broader marketing, revenue, and profitability objectives.

Using historical performance and financial data, I developed forecasts that established realistic growth targets and clear roadmaps for achieving them. I then carried those strategies through execution by managing digital marketing campaigns and optimizing performance.

- Directly managed millions of dollars in paid media spend across clients
- Improved Kynship’s core financial forecasting systems for use across its client portfolio 
- Partnered directly with C-suite executives on growth and profitability strategy 
- Worked with 15+ DTC brands generating between $100,000 and $20 million in annual revenue

positions.title: Creative Producer
positions.description:
At Ghost Golf, I led creative execution across e-commerce, advertising, and brand development. I translated business goals into cohesive digital experiences and campaigns, owning projects from conception all the way through to delivery. This role built my foundation in UX design, user-focused problem-solving, and cross-functional execution across multiple domains within a business.
 
- Website UX and visual design 
- Creative direction and brand strategy 
- Advertising strategy, creation, and brand campaign development 
- Photography, videography, graphic design, and copywriting

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Promoted from barista to manager, I led daily operations, supervised the team, and improved workflows to keep service running efficiently. The role strengthened my leadership, communication, and process improvement skills, which I now bring to collaborative technical work.

projects.title: Vehicle Telemetry Monitor
projects.description:
- Designed and built Python CLI that ingests vehicle telemetry and validates readings against configurable
operating thresholds, with capability to output into MySQL
- Implemented JSON-configurable, rule-based anomaly detection across incoming vehicle telemetry data,
producing timestamped diagnostic alerts and checking against metric-specific conditions
- Built a pytest suite covering certain abnormal readings, boundary conditions, missing fields, malformed inputs,
and configurable operating ranges
